title: Label Transport Along a Walk
statement: Let $q$ be a natural number and let a finite unique game have a nonempty finite vertex set and a nonempty finite set of constraint occurrences, each joining distinct vertices and carrying a permutation of $\{0,\ldots,q-1\}$; assume every vertex occurs in some constraint. If a labeling satisfies every constraint, then along any walk from a vertex $u$ to a vertex $v$, the label at $v$ is the transport of the label at $u$, applying each edge permutation in the direction prescribed by the walk.
hypotheses_covered: A permutation of the label set for each constraint
Every vertex participates in a constraint
A walk between the stated vertices
